title: Imi Miriam

paragraphs: Abba Shaul son of Imi Miriam, [Ketubot 87a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.87a.9-10). Hyman identifies this as a woman’s name, citing [Tosafot on Bava Batra 149a, s.v. Rav Mari](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Bava_Batra.149a.3.2).[^1]

notes.text: Ketubot has the form Imma Miriam. Tosafot includes Abba Shaul among examples of people named after their mothers.
